historical_record.description: On discretionary review the City Planning Commission approved, 4-2, a live/work project of up to seven artists' live/work units and up to seven commercial units beside an existing nightclub (Motion 13628).

On discretionary review the City Planning Commission approved, 4-3 and with conditions, the revised live/work project: seven artists' live/work units of about 1,000 square feet and 21 commercial units in two buildings, with 37 parking spaces (Motion 13773).
On discretionary review, the City Planning Commission refused, 5-0, the conversion of a building approved as 20 commercial lofts, and one more loft then under construction, into live/work units.
